result.summary: The image shows a wide urban street with a well-maintained sidewalk on the right, bordered by a parking garage and high-rise buildings. A large construction truck on the left and a parking garage entrance on the right present potential conflict points and visual obstructions for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Large Vehicle Obstruction
hazards.description: A large flatbed truck on the left side of the street significantly blocks sight lines for both pedestrians and other drivers.

hazards.name: Driveway Conflict Point
hazards.description: The entrance to a parking garage creates a point where vehicles cross the pedestrian walkway, increasing the risk of collisions.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the parking garage entrance to narrow the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lane
interventions.description: Convert the wide shoulder into a protected bike lane to provide a physical buffer between pedestrians and motor vehicles.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add high-visibility marked crosswalks at the nearest intersections to clearly define pedestrian space.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, well-maintained concrete sidewalk in a commercial area, protected from the roadway by bollards. The building frontage features a restaurant at ground level with a large parking structure or blank wall above, creating a somewhat sterile pedestrian environment.

hazards.name: Blank frontage
hazards.description: The large expanse of blank wall and parking garage structure above the ground floor reduces natural surveillance and creates a less engaging environment for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Upper two-thirds of the building facade

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Planting street trees along the curb would provide shade, improve air quality, and create a more pleasant buffer between pedestrians and the roadway.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Installing pedestrian-scale street lights would improve visibility and the perception of safety during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Active Frontage Improvements
interventions.description: Encouraging more transparent windows or artistic treatments on the blank upper walls could improve the visual interest and perceived safety of the block.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features wide, well-maintained sidewalks and high-visibility continental crosswalks at a signalized intersection. However, the multi-lane roadway creates a significant crossing distance, increasing pedestrian exposure to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide multi-lane roadway requires pedestrians to spend a significant amount of time in the conflict zone during a single crossing phase.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway at the intersection

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radii
hazards.description: The intersection geometry appears to allow for relatively high-speed vehicle turns, increasing risk for pedestrians in the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to reduce crossing distance and slow turning traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a median refuge to allow pedestrians to cross the wide street in two stages.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles receive a green light.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban arterial road with multiple travel lanes and high-rise commercial buildings. While sidewalks are present on both sides, the environment is vehicle-centric with long crossing distances and faded pedestrian markings.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The yellow crosswalk markings in the foreground are significantly faded, reducing visibility for drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The roadway is very wide with at least four travel lanes and no median refuge, exposing pedestrians to traffic for a long duration.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse markings with high-visibility continental (ladder) style markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve sight lines between pedestrians and drivers.
